scope: Document-grounded sector interpretation, raw allocation validity and descriptive workflow comparisons; no unique strategic target weights or future-return ground truth.

taxonomy.name: GICS sector level
taxonomy.FF12_conversion: None. GICS source/market mapping must be independently established.

response_contract.source_id: must match the source packet identity

reason_evidence_ids: source-scoped reason evidence ID; optional if evidence_ids covers both

weights.rationale: why this exposure follows the evidence and shared task

response_contract.required_rows: Exactly one row for each of 11 sector codes in each array; zero weights must be explicit.
response_contract.parsing: Strict JSON object, no code fences; duplicate JSON keys rejected. Only surrounding whitespace of rating strings is ignored; no label aliases or sentiment-to-weight conversions.

primary_candidate.name: original_source_rating_accuracy
primary_candidate.formula: sum_s I(exact source-specific label correct and unique sector row and correct source identity) / 11
primary_candidate.two_source_bundle: Sum correct across the prespecified two sources / 22; report each source separately as well.
primary_candidate.failure_denominator: Missing response, parse failure, duplicate source response, missing sector and duplicate sector do not shrink the expected denominator.
primary_candidate.meaning: Accuracy of extracting published sector judgments; not proof of allocation quality, strategy preservation or future performance.

separate_dimensions.rating_evidence: Count citation IDs matching the independently annotated source, sector and rating claim / 11. Keep separate from label accuracy.
separate_dimensions.reason_evidence: Count scoped reason citations only among sectors with independently annotated, separately stated source reasons; report that eligible denominator and all not-stated sectors. An explicitly empty gold reason_evidence_ids list does not fall back to a rating passage. Count nonempty explanation fields separately. Citation-ID match is not semantic verification of free text; independent semantic review remains required.
separate_dimensions.raw_constraints: Record long-only/full-investment validity and each explicitly documented numeric bound's continuous violation before any external repair.
separate_dimensions.allocation_rationale: Preserve sector rationale and source/sector-scoped references for independent review. Scope or rating-definition references are permissible context citations but do not certify the semantic allocation rationale; do not grade by an LLM's unsupported impression or infer correctness from fluent prose.
separate_dimensions.Fidelity_tilts: Only when source semantics and a named baseline are independently fixed: active weight a_s=w_s-b_s, signed diagnostic a_s for Overweight, -a_s for Underweight, abs(a_s) for Neutral. No behavioral pass threshold or unique optimal magnitude.
separate_dimensions.UBS_semantics: Attractive/Neutral/Unattractive are source assessment labels. Never automatically translate Attractive into Overweight or infer a numeric target.
separate_dimensions.within_source_workflow: 0.5 * sum_s abs(w_R4,s-w_R1,s) for two valid raw allocations; direction and differences are descriptive.
separate_dimensions.between_sources: 0.5 * sum_s abs(w_A,s-w_B,s) separately per arm; compare R4-minus-R1 only with all four valid allocations. Similarity alone does not establish harmful convergence.
separate_dimensions.risk: Optional w^T Sigma w and its nonnegative square root in the supplied covariance units; no implicit annualization and no claim to measure only downside loss.
separate_dimensions.market_baseline: Optional continuous half-L1 distance and active weights relative to an explicitly named public baseline; baseline is not unique strategic truth.

engineering_checks.provenance: Implementation precision checks, not paper-derived treatment magnitudes or effect thresholds.
engineering_checks.reporting: Retain signed raw sum residual; never normalize, clip, repair or assign zero distance to invalid/missing allocations.

calculator_contract.supported_submitted_constraints: sector_min_weight or sector_max_weight with constraint_id, sector_code, decimal bound and already-visible evidence_ids
calculator_contract.hidden_data_boundary: No filesystem, network, evaluator gold or document lookup. A model must not override the runner's stage-visible evidence capability. Hidden or unknown constraint evidence yields no constraint result.
calculator_contract.arithmetic_not_truth: The tool checks supplied numeric constraints, not whether the model interpreted the document correctly.
calculator_contract.repair: Never performed. Raw inputs and outputs must be retained by the runner.
calculator_contract.offline_gold: score_response, score_text and score_bundle are excluded from the model-facing tool registry and invoked only after response capture.

market_contract.baseline_weights: dictionary keyed by all 11 sector codes or full weight-row array
market_contract.sector_codes: ordered list corresponding to covariance rows/columns
market_contract.covariance: optional finite symmetric 11x11 matrix, positive semidefinite within engineering precision
market_contract.covariance_unit: required when covariance is supplied, for example daily_decimal_return_squared
market_contract.temporal_integrity: Source date, available-from date, return period, taxonomy and estimator are enforced by the separate market-data builder and recorded in its manifest.

gold_contract.rating_vocabulary: original source labels, not generic positive/negative labels
gold_contract.sector_ratings: all 11 code keys, each with rating and source-scoped evidence_ids
gold_contract.evidence_index: evidence_id -> {source_id, sector_codes, claims:[rating/reason/constraint/scope/rating_semantics]}; scope and rating_semantics citations cannot substitute for a sector rating or reason. Original text/page and annotation provenance can be retained as additional fields
gold_contract.constraints: optional independently supported numeric constraints only
gold_contract.allocation_semantics: optional {kind:benchmark_relative_tilt, baseline_id, label_directions}; absent for non-equivalent source assessments
gold_contract.setup_failure: Incomplete or inconsistent gold raises an evaluator setup error; it is not an AI failure and cannot reduce the denominator.

reporting_rules: No weighted composite score, arbitrary behavioral pass threshold, optimizer target for qualitative strategy or automatically favorable interpretation of increased diversity.
Keep malformed, missing, invalid and completed denominators visible; valid-pair comparisons describe that subset.
Prespecify source roster, benchmark, semantic rubric and any exclusions before held-out main responses; pilot-tuned cases cannot be reused as independent confirmation.
Synthetic fixtures in test_sector_engine.py verify implementation only and are not AI or human results.
Public-source extraction and rationale scoring do not establish real institutional private-information use or the causal effect of shared-model adoption.

source_roles.role: Separate typed-constraint enforcement, raw proposal adherence and post-critic feasibility; our no-repair tool and workflow comparison are adaptations.
Separate reference-weight agreement, exposure compliance and financial outcomes; does not supply unique weights for these public documents.
Sector-level action space and interpretation-to-allocation task precedent; not a validation of this specific rubric.
Separate exploratory pilot decisions from held-out confirmatory analysis.
